ph: After bathing Lord Harikrishna Maharaj in the ocean waters, Swamishri prays for rain in the whole of Gujarat and offers obeisance to the sun-god. 14 Sept 99

w: At 11.30 am Swamishri visited the Sanatan Mandir that was under construction and showered flowers on the unconsecrated murtis.

The evening assembly was declared as Kishore Day. Firstly Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by carrying out a colourful procession that concluded in the assembly hall. The Kishores of Los Angeles performed a drama 'Drishta' and presented a slide show of Swamishri's memories during his 7-day stay in Los Angeles.

The Kishore Day programs in the evening assembly was based on the theme of "Tu Din Kahe to din..." After a speech by sadhus, the Kishores performed a drama, "Hari gamtama rahevuji..." After a folk dance by the kishores, Swamishri blessed the assembly emphasizing on obeying God's commands.

The shraddh assembly commenced after Swamishri's puja. Students of 'Pramukh Swami Vidya Mandir' performed a traditional dance on the lyric 'Malya mune Shastriji Maharaj'. Pujya Brahmadarshan Swami, Pujya Ghanshyamcharan Swami, Pujya Siddheshwar Swami and Shri Haka Bapu spoke about the glory of Shastriji Maharaj and his love for Swamishri. After the rendering of bhajan 'Gunatit ka danka alamme...' by sadhus, Swamishri blessed the assembly. He said, "Shastriji Maharaj established this organization from nothing. At that time we had nothing. And in those circumstances Shastriji Maharaj built such huge mandirs and developed the Satsang organization. Its glory has spread throughout the world. If one is proud of this then one should experience joy and spirit of being blessed. Shastriji Maharaj's work was not a show. He had come on this earth with the principle preached by Shriji Maharaj. His mission was to explain the knowledge of Akshar and Purushottam ..." More than 13,000 devotees attended the festival and had mahaprasad of dudhpak.
ph: Swamishri performs puja on Shraddh day with the murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Shastriji Maharaj in the backdrop

w: Arrangements had been made to celebrate the Jaljhilani Ekadashi festival at the Yagnapurush Sarovar. A stage had been erected in the middle, with the sadhus and devotees seated on the banks. After the traditional Vedic mahapuja rituals, Swamishri bathed Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Then, as per tradition Swamishri sat with Thakorji in a motorboat and sailed around the Yagnapurush Sarovar five times. After each round arti was performed and thal was offered to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj.

A young doctor met Swamishri. He was studying surgery, but because he found it difficult he was feeling depressed. He even contemplated on committing suicide. Swamishri asked him, “Why do you feel this way.” He replied, “No matter how hard I work I simply can’t cope up. Because of this my seniors are harassing me. I feel as if I won’t be able to study at all.” Swamishri advised, “If that is so then change your subject to another stream of medicine. Don’t ever contemplate committing suicide. There is no need to die. And don’t slip into the habit of addictions. Pray to God. I too will pray for you. Things will work out well.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
